title: Part of a store closing
content: Last week I think it was, I dreamt of a outer shop of mallworld, a very strange combination between an automotive shop and a pond hobby shop. Had "everything must go" signage everywhere. The workers seemed forlorn. I even vaguely remember a worker lamenting about being a manager at the store for the last 6 years. Unusually hot outside. Some sort of "model makeover" shop of all places crawling with agents. An outside posh fountain covered in fancy tile, with workers seemingly evacuating the nearby office complex.
